[[Espérance de Tunis|EST]] 5-1 [[JS Kairouan|JSK]] | biggest away win = [[Stade Gabèsien|SG]] 1-6 [[Etoile du Sahel|ESS]] | highest scoring = [[Stade Gabèsien|SG]] 1-6 [[Etoile du Sahel|ESS]] | matches = 125 | total goals = 261 | prevseason = [[2011–12 Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 1|2011–12]] | nextseason = [[2013–14 Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 1|2013–14]] }} The '''2012–13 [[Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 1]]''' (''Tunisian Professional League'') season was the 58th season of top-tier [[football in Tunisia]]. The competition began on 10 November 2012 and was scheduled to conclude in June 2013. The defending champions from the [[2011–12 Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 1|previous season]] were [[Espérance Sportive de Tunis]].{{cite web|title=Season 2011-12|url=https://int.soccerway.com/national/tunisia/ligue-1/2011-2012/regular-season/|publisher=Soccerway|access-date=5 November 2012}} ==Team and format changes== [[2011–12 Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 1|Last season]] two teams were relegated as usual ([[AS Gabès]] and [[ES Beni-Khalled]]), with two teams promoted from the [[Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 2]] to replace them ([[Olympique du Kef]] and [[Stade Gabèsien]]). However, in a change from previous seasons, the league was split into two groups of 8 teams.{{cite web|title=Season 2012-13|url=https://int.soccerway.com/national/tunisia/ligue-1/20122013/regular-season/|publisher=Soccerway|access-date=5 November 2012}} ==Teams and venues== ===Group A=== {{Location map+ |Tunisia |float=right |caption=Location of teams in '''2012–13 Tunisian Ligue Professionelle 1
